name: End Of Time
overview: Scripture reveals that the end of time will be marked by an increase in knowledge and widespread movement, as foretold in Daniel's prophecy. Jesus teaches that before the end comes, the gospel will be preached to all nations, and believers must endure through unprecedented tribulation to be saved. These difficult days will be intense but shortened for the sake of the elect, emphasizing God's sovereign protection and the necessity of steadfast faith until the very end.
